style.styleTitle: Nkuku Set of 4 Tamti Christmas Baubles
style.toneOfVoice: Full of character along with colour, the Tamti baubles bring a playful energy to festive decorating. Made in vibrant teal with a crackled glass finish, each one catches the light with a soft shimmer and subtle texture. Tied with bright, sari ribbons, they celebrate a more joyful, relaxed approach to Christmas. These are ideal for mixing into trees and garlands, or styled as part of a colourful table setting. Each Sari tie is one of a kind, so the piece you receive will vary slightly from the images shown, due to its individual character.
